title: Variable-Horizon Model Predictive Control for Switched Systems
summary: This paper investigates model predictive control (MPC) for switched systems subject to control and state constraints. A variable-horizon switched MPC approach is proposed. By steering the system state into a well-designed switching feasible set, the proposed method structurally decouples the dwell-time conditions from the MPC constraints, thereby relaxing the dwell-time requirements to match those of the unconstrained switched systems.
